title: A quasiconformal variant of the union problem
summary: The Union Problem, which has its genesis in the classical Levi problem, asks for a classification of complex manifolds $M$ that can be exhausted by an increasing union of submanifolds $M_j \subset M$ which are all biholomorphic to a fixed domain in $\mathbb C^n$. We explore a quasiconformal variant of this question and seek to classify $n$-Riemannian manifolds $M$ such that each $M_j$ is quasiconformally equivalent to a bounded domain in $\mathbb R^n$.
